article.title: Press V2 Layout Preview: Week 3 From Rout to Reversal
article.dek: A review-only demonstration of the long-form story hierarchy, verified gamebook, and source rail using the already-published Week 3 record.

thesis.text: Week 3 stretched from maco71’s 73.42-point rout to Archibaldo’s 4.52-point escape, while cuch claimed the scoring headline at 154.48.

lead.text: The scoreboard offered three different kinds of consequence. maco71 produced the week’s widest margin, Archibaldo delivered its closest finish, and cuch raised the highest total of the six winners.

This page is a format preview built from the frozen, already-published Week 3 results. It demonstrates the V2 reading experience without making an OpenAI request or claiming to be a newly approved article.

mainEvent.headline: maco71 Turns Thursday’s Opening Into the Week’s Defining Rout

body.text: maco71 defeated pgorny 135.70–62.28, a 73.42-point margin that stood as the largest gap of Week 3. Bijan Robinson led the winning lineup with 34.3 points.
The result gave the V2 front page a true main event: not merely the first matchup listed, but the game whose scale most clearly changed how the week should be remembered.

supportingStories.headline: Archibaldo Finds Four and a Half Points of Separation

body.text: Archibaldo beat Blumbo 108.54–104.02 in the week’s tightest final. The 4.52-point margin carried more tension than the other five scoreboards combined could manufacture.
The frozen Friday outlook had leaned toward Blumbo after Thursday, but it was always a post-kickoff outlook rather than an original prediction receipt.

supportingStories.headline: cuch Owns the Number at the Top of the Page

body.text: cuch posted 154.48, the highest score of Week 3, and defeated vpitello34 129.36. Jaxon Smith-Njigba supplied 30.36 points for the winning lineup.
vpitello34 still reached 129.36 behind Jahmyr Gibbs’s 37.9, turning a strong losing score into an essential part of the week’s scoring story.
The week’s extremes arrived in Matchups 1 and 2: one result was decided by 73.42, the other by 4.52.
cuch and maco71 left Week 3 with the two loudest winning totals, giving the next power-ranking update more than one credible lead candidate.
Week 3 had no original pregame Preview, so the Friday lean remains preserved for context and excluded from original-prediction grading.
The next edition inherits three live threads: cuch’s scoring ceiling, maco71’s week-winning margin, and Archibaldo’s ability to turn a narrow forecast against its favorite.

aroundLeague.headline: jwislek_20 Makes a Close Outlook Look Distant
aroundLeague.body: jwislek_20 defeated martinch94 131.88–86.94, turning a narrow Friday outlook into a 44.94-point final margin.

aroundLeague.headline: Siccboi Protects the Thursday Head Start
aroundLeague.body: Siccboi carried the early advantage into a 134.64–103.14 win over sidjunlee, with Drake London’s 23.9-point opener setting the direction.

aroundLeague.headline: turi70 Converts the Early Edge
aroundLeague.body: turi70 beat akaaashh 115.94–80.76 after Christian Watson supplied 19.1 on Thursday.
